questions.q: What is a Return Material Authorization (RMA)?
options: A new, unrelated sales order
A type of credit check hold
A return order, created with reference to the original sales order, used to manage goods coming back
A discount applied automatically at order entry
questions.explain: An RMA is a return order generated with reference to the original sales order, specifically to manage the return process.

questions.q: Why can't the 20 damaged units simply be removed from SO-48217 with a line edit?
options: Because the goods already shipped and were confirmed, so the correction requires a return process instead
Because line edits are never allowed on any order
Because Harborview refused to pay
Because the item was discontinued
questions.explain: Once goods have shipped and been confirmed, a quantity reduction requires a return (RMA), not an ordinary line edit.

questions.q: Put these RMA steps in the correct order.
options: Inspection, Receipt, Authorization, Request
Authorization, Inspection, Request, Receipt
Receipt, Request, Inspection, Authorization
Request, Authorization, Receipt, Inspection
questions.explain: The RMA process runs: request, authorization, receipt of the physical goods, then inspection.

questions.q: What happened to the 20 returned units from SO-48217 at inspection?
options: They passed and were returned to sellable inventory
They failed inspection due to shipping damage and were slated for disposal
They were automatically re-shipped to Harborview
They were never received back at all
questions.explain: Given visible shipping damage, the 20 units failed inspection and were slated for disposal rather than resale.

questions.q: Why does the RMA need to reference the original sales order (SO-48217) directly?
options: It doesn't need to — RMAs are always standalone
So the customer's credit limit can be reduced
So the system can later connect the return to the correct invoice for an accurate credit
So the warehouse address can be changed
questions.explain: Referencing the original order is what allows the return to later connect to the right invoice and generate an accurate credit memo.
